svg.title: Ongoing / Proposal: seams and boundaries
svg.desc: The same proposed subsystem under the trust lens: which parts share the one HTTP contract, which are pure rules the browser re-runs, what the durable state is, and which pieces exist so that discovery, hosting, issues, the serving host, and the deploy target stop being assumptions.. Colored outlines mark exact authored boundary members, not inferred trust envelopes.
